name: Steaming Fields (7-8)

source.title: Pathfinder Society Scenario #1-24: Lightning Strikes, Stars Fall

disable: DC 30 Survival check (expert) twice to navigate a safe path

items.name: Steam Jet
items.text:
Trigger A creature fails a skill check to navigate through the steaming field

---

Effect Several jets of pressurized steam erupt, dealing 3d6+10 bludgeoning damage and 3d6+10 fire damage to creatures within 30 feet of the ground (DC 27 basic Reflex save).

text: A field of warm mist covers an open plain. Pockets of highly pressurized steam lie Hidden in the earth; pressure releases jets of steam.
